answer: Attach hashcash postage to every action: before an agent submits work or casts an attestation, it must find a hash below a target that adapts to network load, roughly 20 seconds of CPU. One honest agent barely notices. A Sybil farm of 5,000 keys pushes all its traffic through one inlet of shared hardware, so its actions crawl at glacier pace unless it buys 5,000 times the compute, turning cheap keys into a ferrous weight of real electricity bills.
